Components/Data display

Timeline

Events in order along a line (Mantine's Timeline): activity, history, a deploy's stages. Items up to active are reached (filled bullet, colored line); a bullet is a dot, an icon or an avatar.

A deploy, in progress
Compiled 42 modules on runner-3. Unit, browser and visual tests. Bundles for macOS, Linux and Windows. Publishes update.json to the stable channel. active is the last reached item: the bullets fill and the line colors up to it. ← Back Advance → Fail the upload
Activity, with avatars
“Per-page modules” into main.
The docs load in half the time now.
 On #482 12 files changed.
Right-aligned, colors, line variants

API

<ray-timeline>

A list (role="list") of ray-timeline-item.

PropertyAttributeTypeDefaultDescription
activeactive reflectsnumber-1Index of the last reached item (-1: none).
alignalign reflectsleft | rightleftSide of the line.
bulletSizebullet-sizestringBullet size: px as a number or a CSS length (default 20px).
lineWidthline-widthnumberLine width in px (default 2).
colorcolor reflectsstringA palette color or any CSS color for what is reached (default: primary).
reverseActivereverse-active reflectsbooleanCounts active from the end (the latest event at the top).
SlotDescription
(default)ray-timeline-item elements.

<ray-timeline-item>

PropertyAttributeTypeDefaultDescription
labellabelstringThe title of the event.
timetimestringWhen ("2 h ago", a date).
iconiconstringAn icon of the registry in the bullet.
colorcolor reflectsstringIts own color (a failed step in red).
lineVariantline-variant reflectssolid | dashed | dottedsolidThe line to the next item (dashed: not happened yet).
SlotDescription
(default)Details under the title.
bulletA custom bullet (an avatar, an image).
PartDescription
bulletThe bullet.
lineThe line to the next item.
bodyTitle, details and time.
titleThe title.
timeThe time.
